CustomField.description: The id of this agent in an external AI service, such as the Anthropic Agent API agent id (agent_...), so the agent can be matched to it without relying on the Salesforce record Id.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Enter the id the external AI service gave this agent, for example agent_... for the Anthropic Agent API. Keep it stable: changing it breaks the link to the external agent.
CustomField.label: External Reference
